task.description: Fix ISS-0001: the three unrealistic paths print a Node stack trace instead of an error code. Read through readTextFile (tools/src/util.js) and report E_VERDICT_MD (validate.js, reading verdict-N.md in checkVerdict), E_STATE_ANCHOR (apply.js, reading STATE.md), E_USAGE (cli.js read for snapshot-diff), with the exit codes the design gives (docs/design/REQ-002-idea-verdict.md §6-§7). One test per case; each failure test also checks that nothing was written (Q5). Use only error codes and meanings that the design already defines; if a case does not fit them, stop and report instead of inventing one.
acceptance_criteria: each of the 3 cases: exit code and error code as in the design, no stack trace on stderr (test asserts it)
each failure test asserts the state did not change (files/listing unchanged)
edits only in tools/src/validate.js, apply.js, cli.js, util.js if needed, and tools/test/; not package.json, eslint.config.js or anything outside tools/
cd tools && npm run check exits 0; output (last lines, test count) in result

result.summary: ISS-0001 fixed. The three paths now read through readTextFile (tools/src/util.js, unchanged) and print a design §6 error line instead of a Node stack trace: (1) validate, verdict-N.md is a folder or unreadable -> 'E_VERDICT_MD verdict-N.md: ...', exit 1; (2) apply-verdict, STATE.md is a folder -> 'E_STATE_ANCHOR STATE.md: ...', exit 1, nothing written; (3) snapshot-diff, a folder instead of a snapshot file -> 'E_USAGE: ...', exit 2. No new code or meaning: each case joins the missing-file case that already mapped to the same code (E_VERDICT_MD 'нет .md'; E_STATE_ANCHOR for a missing STATE.md, with its existing test; E_USAGE 'snapshot not found'). Tests: 4 new in tools/test/cli.test.js, one per case plus a second one for case 1, because the issue names two variants (folder, unreadable). Each runs the real CLI and asserts the exit code, the error line, no '    at ' line on stderr (the design §9 Q10 pattern) and an unchanged tree() (recursive paths + sha256) of the project or snapshot folder (Q5). Proof that the tests catch the defect: original src + new cli.test.js in a scratch copy -> the 4 new tests fail (3 on the stderr match, because the crash also exits 1; snapshot-diff on exit 1 instead of 2) and the 9 old ones pass; with the fix all pass. Scratch runs (not in the suite) also show unreadable STATE.md -> E_STATE_ANCHOR exit 1 and unreadable snapshot -> E_USAGE exit 2, no stack trace, nothing changed. Check 'cd tools && npm run check' -> exit 0 (baseline before the change: exit 0, 111 tests). Last lines of the output: 'All matched files use Prettier code style!'; 'eslint . --max-warnings 0' with no findings; '1..115', '# tests 115', '# suites 0', '# pass 115', '# fail 0', '# cancelled 0', '# skipped 0', '# todo 0'. Test count: 115 (111 + 4). Scope: only the 4 files in changes; util.js byte-identical; package.json, package-lock.json and eslint.config.js untouched (mtime 2026-09-25); nothing outside tools/ edited except this handoff; the issue file not touched. The diff has no skip/todo/only, no eslint-disable, no masked exit code. Every save kept tools/ runnable for the parallel REQ-ANALYST: readTextFile was already exported by util.js, and each import was added before its first use. Out-of-scope findings (not fixed: outside this task, and §6 has no code for a failed write) are in result.issues for ORCH to register.

changes.change: checkVerdict reads verdict-N.md through readTextFile (was fs.existsSync + fs.readFileSync). Missing, a folder or unreadable all give E_VERDICT_MD (design §4.8, §6), exit 1. Message now 'must be a readable file, mention the chosen idea and contain ## Ограничения' (was 'must exist, ...'). readTextFile was already imported.

applyVerdict reads STATE.md through readTextFile (was fs.existsSync + fs.readFileSync). Missing, a folder or unreadable give 'E_STATE_ANCHOR STATE.md: STATE.md missing, not a file or unreadable' (was 'STATE.md not found'), exit 1, before any write. readTextFile added to the ./util.js import.

snapshot-diff 'read' uses readTextFile (was fs.existsSync + fs.readFileSync). A missing, folder or unreadable snapshot throws UsageError 'snapshot missing, not a file or unreadable: <path>' -> E_USAGE, exit 2. readTextFile added to the ./util.js import.

Imports tree from helpers.js. New helper failsCleanly(dir, exitCode, line, command) asserts the exit code, the error line on stderr, no '    at ' stack-trace line, and tree(dir) unchanged. 4 new tests: validate with verdict-1.md as a folder; validate with verdict-1.md unreadable (chmod 000, restored in finally; like the existing E_SOURCE_CHANGED test it needs a non-root user); apply-verdict with STATE.md as a folder; snapshot-diff with a folder as <after>. Existing tests unchanged.

issues.title: apply-verdict writes STATE.md and then crashes if a later target in the run folder is a folder
issues.evidence: Scratch runs of the fixed CLI on a valid fixture run: runs/<RUN-ID>/proposed-actions.json created as a folder -> exit 1, Node stack trace 'Error: EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory, read', STATE.md already rewritten. apply-report.json as a folder -> same, with STATE.md and proposed-actions.json already written.
issues.where: tools/src/apply.js write loop (fs.existsSync + fs.readFileSync of an existing target, then fs.writeFileSync)
issues.why: Breaks design §5 ('any issue means nothing is written'). Unlike ISS-0001 it leaves a half-applied state. It needs a deliberately created folder, so it is not a realistic failure.
issues.proposal: New issue via ORCH: CODE-DESIGNER defines a pre-write check of every target (absent or a regular file) and its §6 code; BACKEND-DEV implements it with a test per target that asserts an unchanged tree().

issues.title: More Node stack traces on unrealistic paths, same class as ISS-0001; each fails before any write
evidence: apply-verdict, STATE.md read-only (chmod 444): EACCES on write (apply.js write loop)
snapshot, output path is a folder: EISDIR (cli.js snapshot, fs.writeFileSync)
snapshot, a file under --root unreadable: EACCES (snapshot.js, fs.readFileSync)
snapshot, --root does not exist: ENOENT scandir (util.js listFiles, fs.readdirSync)
prepare-run, runs is a file: ENOTDIR mkdir (prepare.js, fs.mkdirSync)
validate, run folder without read permission (mode 300): EACCES scandir (validate.js checkUnknownLensFiles, fs.readdirSync)
issues.note: Each one reproduced with the fixed CLI in scratch temp folders: exit 1 with a stack trace. Write failures have no §6 code, so they need a design decision, not a guess.
issues.proposal: One follow-up issue that sweeps every fs call in tools/src, not only these, with a test per call site.

issues.detail: readTextFile fixed some reads earlier; RELEASE-VALIDATOR then found 3 more (ISS-0001); this run found 8 more of the same class (the two entries above). Candidate anti-pattern: when fixing a class of defect, search every call site and fix or list them in the same work.

issues.title: Design §6 rows do not name these cases
issues.detail: E_VERDICT_MD ('нет .md'), E_STATE_ANCHOR ('нет строки-якоря ...') and E_USAGE (snapshot files not mentioned) now also cover 'missing, not a file or unreadable'. The code follows the existing precedent (a missing STATE.md and a missing snapshot already used these codes). DOC-UPDATER may add these words to the 'Когда' column.
